_CLUSTERS._rule: CORRELATED POSITIONS SHARE ONE TAIL BUDGET. Before adding a position, sum the anchors of every OPEN position in its cluster + the new one; the sum must fit the undefined-risk cap (5-7% of equity, RiskConfig). Members of different clusters size independently. Measured 2026-07-24 from 4,495 days of our GLBX continuous data.

EQUITY_INDEX.note: MES put + MNQ put = same trade, NQ falls 1.14x harder on crash days. Stock puts carry the same beta - count gated stock puts here too.

CROSS_CLUSTER_CORR_TO_ES.note: GC/CL/NG/ZB lines are REAL diversification vs index puts, even in crashes.

METALS.note: Gold = BEST diversifier in book (0.08 daily, 0.07 crash — flight-to-safety hedge). Separate 5% tail budget, confirmed same logic as ENERGY. GC+SI are ONE cluster (0.80 corr) — share the 5%, never stack. SI is PAPER-ONLY (rejected except bb_2sd puts +$413/tr n=35 journal); metals budget = GC puts for now (+$303/tr licensed).

ENERGY.note: CL+NG ~0.11 to equities AND to each other — nearly independent. Separate 5% tail. Confirmed improves book MAR 0.49->0.56, DD unchanged.

_CLUSTERS._decision_framework: Add any new asset class as a SEPARATE cluster budget IFF: (1) corr<~0.3 to existing clusters (genuine diversification), (2) instruments within it that correlate >~0.6 SHARE one budget (don't stack), (3) the line is LICENSED not paper, (4) energy-style sim confirms it improves book MAR with DD unchanged. Per-cluster tail <=5%; TOTAL across all clusters <=~12-15% (crisis-correlation buffer).

_SIZING._rule: qty = clamp(floor(risk_pct * equity / worst_loss_anchor), 1, PER_LINE_CAP). risk_pct=0.02 (2%, do NOT raise — MAR peaks ~3%, falls after). Anchor = worst historical loss per line (micro = full/10). NEVER size off broker BPR/margin (understates tail).

PER_LINE_CAP._note: micro-futures call cap raised 3->5 (OOS-validated 2026-07-27, TEST MAR .59->.85, worst trade unchanged). NG NOT higher than CL despite tiny anchor — weather-tail discipline. Stocks/ES/GC/NQ unchanged.

_SIZING._rejected: uncapping NG to ~20+ lots (its ~$45 anchor allows it) gave $117-339K in-sample but is fat weather-tail leverage — rejected on principle.
